text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — weekend search spend spiked on longtail branded queries, CTR fine but CPL jumped. Thinking we throttle weekend bids and push more to weekdays + run webinar promo on Mon-Wed.
Sam: Can you share lift numbers?
Maya: +45% spend Sat-Sun vs baseline, conversions flat so CPL +30%. Not huge volume but burns experiment budget.
Luis: Are these new keywords or seasonal?
Maya: Mostly new low-recency retargeting lists (30–90d) + a few broad match expansions.
Priya: Agreed with throttling. Suggest we also swap creative: run webinar creative (3 slides) to mid-funnel retargeters — CTA: sign up for product deep-dive.
Tanya: I can draft webinar copy. Who owns landing page?
Alex: I can update ad variants. Need exact UTMs and lead routing though.
Maya: Routing: HubSpot workflow forwards webinar signups to SDR queue A if MQL, else nurture. Also want immediate tags so Sales sees "webinar:mar24" and "channel:search".
Priya: UTM template below — use for all webinar promos so we can filter in reports:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_mar24&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative}
```
Luis: For retargeting window changes, propose test: 7d recency (high intent) vs 30d. 7d gets higher conv rate historically.
Maya: Good — run 7d on high bids weekdays, keep 30d on low bids weekends.
Sam: Budget reallocation? How much to pull from weekend?
Maya: Move 40% of weekend search budget to weekday daytime slots (9–5 PST) for two weeks, monitor CPL.
Alex: I'll swap creatives and create two ad groups: webinar_cta_A / webinar_cta_B. A is short copy, B is benefits-led.
Priya: Also request analytics tag: add event "webinar_reg" with field "utm_campaign" so we can join impressions -> leads.
Tanya: Drafting email reminder series for registrants. Also want a slide in the webinar specifically for Dedicated vs Private deployment messaging.
Maya: Yup, pin product differentiation. Also include a short benchmark narrative in the confirmation email: "Most teams see 30–50% lower latency costs with Redwood Optimize in first month" — Priya can iterate.
Priya: I'll draft three variants of benchmark line for A/B.
JenkinsBot: deploy:ad-update pipeline triggered by Alex. status: queued.
Alex: Heads-up — landing page form fields must include "account size" for routing rules. Can devs add that quickly?
Maya: @Luis can you toggle form to include account size + hidden field for utm_campaign?
Luis: On it, will push change by 12:30pm.
Sam: Reporting ask: please add a dashboard card showing CPL by daypart and by recency window. We need to see the effect quickly.
Priya: I'll add card in GA4 + internal dashboard. ETA EOD.
Maya: One more — creative refresh cadence: rotate creatives every 72h for the test period, keep best performing.
Tanya: Got it. Draft webinar landing → will post for review in #marketing-review.
Maya: Thanks all. If we see CPL improvement >15% after 48h, reallocate another 20% from weekend.
Alex: noted. Starting creative push now.
Luis: form change deployed.
Priya: Dashboard card live (preview link: https://dash.redwood.internal/webinar-cpl).
Maya: Nice. We'll sync tomorrow 10am to review first-day data.
Sam: 👍
Tanya: ✅
Alex: 👍 deployed
